data_policy.uncertainty_rule: A null value means the source materials do not establish it. It must not be inferred.

notes: Shot composition (movement_ref per shot) was authored by the assistant, per explicit product-owner instruction, using ONLY the confirmed 28-move canonical catalog — no invented move names. No move repeats within a single plan.
title/description/difficulty/shoot_time_min/filters/tip/transition are editorial copy, authored by the assistant — explicitly allowed to be imperfect for this first working version.
intro_video desktop_id/mobile_id and final_clip_duration_s are unchanged from the confirmed Bunny Stream data (not re-derived).
movement_ref is a move NAME (not yet a GUID) — the 28 real moves' Bunny Stream GUIDs are still pending. getMoveByRef() resolves by normalized title in the meantime.
shot-level duration_s is left null (not established, not invented) — only tip/transition were authored.
plan-intro-* Stream assets are excluded from the Moves tab by loadRealMoves() in library.js — unaffected by this file.

plans.title: Beach
plans.description: 5 shots. A relaxed beach sequence — an orbit on the sand, a rising reveal, and a glide along the shoreline.

shots.tip: Rise slowly as you pull back to reveal the shoreline.
Keep a steady radius circling the subject.
Climb gently while circling to open up the view.
Glide sideways at a constant speed along the shoreline.
Finish high to reveal the full beach and coastline.

plans.title: City Buildings
plans.description: 6 shots. A dynamic urban sequence — descending orbits, a dramatic pull, and a rise to the skyline.

shots.tip: Orbit while gradually losing altitude past the facade.
Fly backward while slowly zooming in for a dramatic pull.
Sweep a wide arc past the skyline at a steady bank.
Circle in and intercept the tower's silhouette.
Climb straight up to reveal the full skyline.
Spin slowly overhead to show the street grid below.

plans.title: Coastline
plans.description: 5 shots. A coastal sequence combining a diving reveal, an orbiting climb, and a wide finishing pull-back.

shots.tip: Approach low and fast, then tilt down into the dive.
Circle while climbing to open up the cove.
Pan smoothly while sliding along the coastline.
Retreat steadily to show the coast at scale.
Combine a pull-back and rise for the biggest reveal last.

plans.title: Ocean Island
plans.description: 5 shots. A wide arc, a tight orbit, and a classic pull-back reveal an island surrounded by open water.

shots.tip: Bank into a wide arc circling the island.
Hold a tight, steady orbit around the island's peak.
Cross the frame on a clean 45° approach.
Retreat and climb together for the classic dronie pull.
Widen out gradually to show the open water around the island.

plans.title: Landscape
plans.description: 6 shots. A layered landscape sequence — a tilt, a push in, a diagonal cross, and a grand finishing reveal.

shots.tip: Hold low, then tilt up to reveal the vista.
Push steadily toward the focal point in the distance.
Cut across the landscape on a clean diagonal.
Descend smoothly to bring the foreground into frame.
Circle while climbing for a wide, open feel.
Finish with a big pull-back and rise for scale.

plans.title: Mountains
plans.description: 5 shots. A mountain sequence built around a tilt reveal, a fly-over, and a wide orbit around the peak.

shots.tip: Start low on the trail, then tilt up to the peak.
Hold a steady altitude flying straight over the ridge.
Circle the peak while gently climbing.
Cross the ridge line on a clean diagonal.
Glide sideways to build depth between ridgelines.

plans.title: Water & Waves
plans.description: 5 shots. A fast, dynamic water sequence with a low pass, an intercepting orbit, and a tracked retreat.

shots.tip: Stay low and level for a fast pass over the water.
Circle in fast toward the subject on the water.
Pull back and rise to reveal the wider scene.
Retreat smoothly to show the water at scale.
Retreat while panning to keep the action framed.

plans.title: Waterfront City
plans.description: 6 shots. A city-meets-water sequence — a descending orbit, a harbor reveal, and a rocket-rise finale.

shots.tip: Start at the waterline, then tilt up to the skyline.
Orbit down toward the waterfront buildings.
Descend to bring the docks and marina into frame.
Pull back and rise to reveal the harbor.
Pan along the waterfront at a steady pace.
Finish with a fast vertical climb over the water and skyline.
